title: The Mission of the Twelve Apostles

questions.question: Who is the first apostle listed in Matthew 10?
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:2 (ESV): "The names of the twelve apostles are these: first, Simon, who is called Peter..."

questions.question: When sending out the twelve, who did Jesus explicitly tell them NOT to go to initially?
options: The Gentiles and any town of the Samaritans
questions.correctAnswer: The Gentiles and any town of the Samaritans
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:5 (ESV): "These twelve Jesus sent out, instructing them, 'Go nowhere among the Gentiles and enter no town of the Samaritans,'"

questions.question: Where were the apostles instructed to go instead?
options: To the lost sheep of the house of Israel
To the furthest corners of the earth
To the outcasts in the wilderness
questions.correctAnswer: To the lost sheep of the house of Israel
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:6 (ESV): "but go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Israel."

questions.question: What were the apostles to do regarding provisions for their journey?
options: Acquire no gold, silver, copper, or extra tunic, for the laborer deserves his food
Bring a strong staff and two tunics
Ask for money only from the wealthy
Bring enough bread for three days
questions.correctAnswer: Acquire no gold, silver, copper, or extra tunic, for the laborer deserves his food
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:9-10 (ESV): "Acquire no gold or silver or copper for your belts, no knapsack for your journey, or two tunics or sandals or a staff, for the laborer deserves his food."

questions.question: If anyone will not receive the apostles or listen to their words, what were they to do as they left that house or town?
options: Shake off the dust from your feet
Leave a curse upon the doorpost
Overturn a table in the street
Pray loudly that fire would fall
questions.correctAnswer: Shake off the dust from your feet
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:14 (ESV): "And if anyone will not receive you or listen to your words, shake off the dust from your feet when you leave that house or town."

questions.question: Jesus said He was sending them out as sheep in the midst of wolves; therefore they should be what?
options: Wise as serpents and innocent as doves
Bold as lions and gentle as lambs
Swift as eagles and quiet as mice
Strong as oxen and patient as camels
questions.correctAnswer: Wise as serpents and innocent as doves
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:16 (ESV): "Behold, I am sending you out as sheep in the midst of wolves, so be wise as serpents and innocent as doves."

questions.question: When the apostles are delivered over to councils and governors, why are they not to be anxious about what to speak?
options: Because what they are to say will be given to them in that hour by the Spirit of their Father
Because their opponents will be struck deaf
Because human words do not matter anyway
Because the angels will speak over them
questions.correctAnswer: Because what they are to say will be given to them in that hour by the Spirit of their Father
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:19-20 (ESV): "...for what you are to say will be given to you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father speaking through you."

questions.question: Jesus said, "You will be hated by all for my name's sake. But the one who ______ to the end will be saved."
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:22 (ESV): "and you will be hated by all for my name's sake. But the one who endures to the end will be saved."

questions.question: When they are persecuted in one town, what does Jesus tell them to do?
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:23 (ESV): "When they persecute you in one town, flee to the next, for truly, I say to you, you will not have gone through all the towns of Israel before the Son of Man comes."

questions.question: Jesus says do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Rather, who should they fear?
options: Him who can destroy both soul and body in hell
The rulers of this present darkness (Satan)
questions.correctAnswer: Him who can destroy both soul and body in hell
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:28 (ESV): "And do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Rather fear him who can destroy both soul and body in hell."

questions.question: To show how much God values them, Jesus mentions what small bird sold for a penny?
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:29 (ESV): "Are not two sparrows sold for a penny? And not one of them will fall to the ground apart from your Father."

questions.question: Jesus says He did not come to bring peace to the earth, but a what?
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:34 (ESV): "Do not think that I have come to bring peace to the earth. I have not come to bring peace, but a sword."

questions.question: Jesus stated that a person's enemies will be whom?
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:36 (ESV): "And a person's enemies will be those of his own household." (Quoting Micah 7:6)

questions.question: What identifies a person as not being worthy of Jesus?
options: Whoever loves father or mother more than Him, or son or daughter more than Him
Whoever refuses to pay the temple tax
Whoever does not sell all their possessions
questions.correctAnswer: Whoever loves father or mother more than Him, or son or daughter more than Him
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:37 (ESV): "Whoever loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me, and whoever loves son or daughter more than me is not worthy of me."

questions.question: What simple act of hospitality done to "one of these little ones" will ensure that a person will not lose his reward?
options: Giving them even a cup of cold water because he is a disciple
questions.correctAnswer: Giving them even a cup of cold water because he is a disciple
questions.explanation: Matthew 10:42 (ESV): "And whoever gives one of these little ones even a cup of cold water because he is a disciple, truly, I say to you, he will by no means lose his reward."

key_verse_text: "Whoever finds his life will lose it, and whoever loses his life for my sake will find it."
